description: This file implements the CourierRenderer class, which manages remote media rendering via RPC communication, including initialization, data pipe setup, handling RPC messages, and performance monitoring within a media remoting context.

classes.name: CourierRenderer
classes.description: Manages remote media rendering, RPC communication, and performance metrics within a media remoting setup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up media resource and RPC data pipes, begins remote renderer setup.

methods.name: SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Placeholder for setting latency hints; currently no implementation.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the renderer, sending RPC flush command and handling callback.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from a specified media time, sending RPC command.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Adjusts playback rate and resets measurements.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level and sends RPC command.

methods.name: GetMediaTime
methods.description: Returns current media time, with thread safety.
